transitionId.description: Unique identifier for the lifecycle transition

description.description: Detailed description of the lifecycle transition

fromState.description: Identifier of the source lifecycle state

toState.description: Identifier of the target lifecycle state

preconditions.description: Conditions that must be met before transition can execute

postconditions.description: Conditions that must be met after transition completes

isRollbackSupported.description: Whether this transition supports automatic rollback

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time allowed for transition execution in seconds
